about_the_game:
I am not a developer.
I was just a platform manager, juggling schedules and builds for Steam and other platforms.

Then one day, my team lead said:

“Let’s study the Steam process. Make a small game we can actually sell.”

“…What? Is he out of his mind?”

And that’s how this unwanted R&D project was born.
The result is this game: simple graphics, simple systems, nothing fancy.
It’s not some grand masterpiece, it’s much closer to a
“practice game made just to actually ship something on Steam.”

So the price is 3,000 KRW (with the launch discount cranked up on top).
Think of it as roughly the price of one piece of fried chicken,
and in return you get to watch a platform manager’s trial-and-error journey
of learning how Steam works.

If you’d like, you can buy it and then come discuss with me
where this game should even go from here.

I’m embarrassed, but we’ve come this far, so we’re releasing it anyway.
All responsibility for the game’s quality lies with my team lead.
I just did what I was told.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AVOID GAME – A dodge action game where quick reactions determine survival!

Control the agile black cat and dodge the rapidly falling raindrops! Your goal? Survive as long as possible while dodging the relentless stream of falling obstacles! As time passes, the speed and patterns change, making the gameplay increasingly challenging. Just how long can you endure?

Game Features:

  • Simple yet addictive gameplay – Controls are easy, but mastery is hard! Survive by dodging obstacles with simple controls.

  • Minimalist Graphic Style – Clean, simple pixel art enhances the game's immersion.

  • Instant action when ready – Get mentally prepared in the menu, then jump right into the game! A fresh challenge unfolds every time.

Test your reaction speed! Challenge your longest survival record in AVOID GAME! 🚀
